description:
One to five supplier quotes, each run as a whole-order plan against the
caller's `profile` through the same engine as `test_order`, and ranked:
feasible first, then total cost, then lead time.

Each quote: `label` and `unit_price` required; `currency` one of GBP, USD,
INR, CNY, EUR, THB, MYR (default GBP); optional `moq_units`, `lead_time_months`,
`payment_terms_months`, `capacity_units_month` and `unit_mass_kg` replace
the profile's figure for that quote only (`inputs_used` says which). Quotes
in one call are ranked against the same plan. A currency with no Bank of
England rate is named in `missing` and not ranked. `verdict` is one
sentence.

Figures carry a `provenance` stamp (READ, MEASURED, DERIVED, COMPUTED, PROXY or ESTIMATED; defined in the server instructions) and a `basis`; `missing` names any figure only the caller holds. Information, not advice.
name: compare_quotes
title: Compare quotes
